text_post: I mentioned this here in the following post: http://forums.avoiceformen.com/showthread.php?pid=72557#pid72557 And, in response I got this muddled post by someone who first gave me a negative mark for this post and insisted it was something he was not going to enable. Supposedly I'm a conspiracy theorist who they would put out there on Fox News. And then he implies such people (medical establishment types interested only in profit) do really exist and might kill me if I turned out to be too much of a "threat" to them by repeating this stuff.  Here let me quote what he said. All I know is, when I asked him to become more specific regarding what it was he objected to with regard to what I said, he simply did not respond and refused to debate me -- just like most feminists.  Interesting thing is, my opinion seems to echo the things this David Horowitz wrote about gay activism and the spread of all sorts of disease, including AIDS. This is a man who grew up with Stalin-supporting parents and broke with them, so his criticism of certain aspects of identity politics are those of someone who viewed it all as an insider -- and it's funny how he comes to the same conclusion that I do. What's interesting about him is that he supports gay marriage -- and that would make a lot of sense and suggest he is principled in his opposition to the gay scene. Or at least this counter culture radical disease promoting agenda. I know for a fact, medical companies and other large corporations were behind all of this -- and if you read the following link, you can see just how much this would have generated HUGE profits off the sale of drugs: http://www.discoverthenetworks.org/Articles/z-RADICAL%20HOLOCAUST.htm ----- I know for a fact, Provincetown and Fire Island -- originally straight fishing communities -- were turned into gay enclaves by medical companies, who sponsored huge sex parties where they handed out antibiotics to every man when he entered the building. Only a connect with a drug company could have made this possible, and I know how something as simple as that would have led to these places being turned into gay enclaves where they could become breeding grounds for disease. The amounts of money to be made by antibiotics manufacturers and other health care concerns -- which include the Catholic Church -- is so high, it would be preposterous to argue they weren't heavily involved in this. The Catholic Church, in particular, is the largest provider of HIV healthcare IN THE WORLD -- and I could attach some articles but it's obvious, with resignation of Pope Benedict, they have been heavily involved in the gay scene for a very long time, what with their network of secretly gay priests involved in all sorts of sex party stuff. More articles here: http://www.discoverthenetworks.org/viewSubCategory.asp?id=276 [hr] http://www.gaystarnews.com/article/priesthood-crisis-dropped-amazoncom-uncovering-gay-sex-priesthood260513 And here -- this is interesting. Somehow Amazon has censured a book on the "powerful gay mafia" in the Catholic Church. Now what would make them so powerful, other than alliances with a corporate world and involvement in issues pertaining to HUGE AMOUNTS OF MONEY? Which is precisely what a disease promoting gay scene would cause. Furthermore, the manner in which the Catholic Church promoted anti gay attitudes allows those radical activist (criminals is what I prefer to call them) who are funded by medical companies to hold up the Catholic Church as a straw man, which they then use as a way to stop the interference of those interested in decent public health measures to protect gay men from disease.  And another thing that is not well known -- this same radical gay activist scene used to be opposed to gay marriage and used to intimidate any gay activists trying to promote gay marriage. So there is a pattern there. Gay activists tried to censure gays who wanted to push for gay marriage, under the feminist theories that marriage was a patriarchal construct or something like that. Basically gay activist opposition to gay marriage were identical to feminist movement opposition to the family way back when. Now, what's going on in the gay scene these days is quite different from before -- but then, I should note one thing: gay activists did not ever support gay marriage until the Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court who consisted of A BUNCH OF STRAIGHT PEOPLE declared gay marriage legal. After that, gay activists were embarrassed into jumping on the gay marriage bandwagon. They had to be dragged kicking and screaming into even recognizing that issue, however. Money talks, and this is all about the corporate world funding rich gays who then protect and privilege themselves even while they throw the rest under the bus. [hr] One thing I do know is, HIV really did kill huge numbers of gay men en masse -- and huge numbers of those employed in the health care establishment who made a lot of money off this disease were, guess who? Lesbians. Then, when the real estate market bottomed out due to so many deaths of gay men in gay enclaves like Provincetown, all the lesbians newly enriched with their often healthcare or social services related careers bought houses up cheaply. And that is why Provincetown is now heavily lesbian, whereas it used to be almost exclusively gay men.  Provincetown is where I met a few gay men living in absolutely wretched conditions on welfare who were HIV positive. One was being abused by the managers of the public housing project he was in -- who were lesbian. His disease meant he was on disability and made only $800 a month income and could not work without losing his benefits. But the drug company got $50K a year payments from the government for his medication, and obviously the Provincetown healthcare establishment and all sorts of layer upon layer of related programs were making probably the same amount off him as well, and treating him pretty shabbily because they felt he was demanding too much of their time needing too much help on a few things. Because of his impoverished state, he relied upon a program that delivered free lunches -- someone else from the home kept stealing his free lunches, and the managers refused to intervene, and when he got angry they tried to force him into anger management therapy.
